_readme: Repoint the site by editing this file on the server and refreshing — no rebuild. Blank values fall back to .env.
_folderId: Drive folder share link. The app lists it and matches spreadsheets to sources BY FILE NAME (Students, Trips, Itinerary, Documents, Guidelines, Reminders, Travel, Media). Requires driveApiKey.
_folderId_status: SET BUT INERT. Two things still needed: (1) share the folder Anyone with the link -> Viewer, it is currently private; (2) supply driveApiKey. Also clear csvBase below.
_sheetId: Alternative to folderId: the link of one spreadsheet holding all the tabs. Used when folderId is blank or a file is missing from it.
_csvBase: Local demo data. MUST be cleared before folderId or sheetId is used at all.
_settingsTab: Tab in the master sheet holding per-source link overrides. Blank links mean 'use the tab of the same name'.
_gids: Only needed if a tab has been renamed — a gid survives renames and wins over the tab name.
_rosterApiUrl: Server-side login lookup. Set to /api/lookup on Netlify. When set, the roster never reaches the browser - only the signed-in parent's own children do. Leave blank and login falls back to matching a client-side roster (demo data only).
_adminEmails: Staff who see every grade. Only used when rosterApiUrl is blank (demo/local). In production set ADMIN_EMAILS in the server environment instead - this file is public, and listing staff here tells anyone which address unlocks all grades.
_driveApiKey: Required for folderId, and for turning a folder link in the Documents tab into one card per file.
_driveApiBase: Leave blank for Google. Set to /sample-drive to demo folder expansion offline.
